title: What Is AI Music for Retail Stores? | Entuned
meta_description: A definitive read on AI music for retail stores in 2026. What it is, what it actually does, what it costs, and how it differs from licensed catalog music.

faq.q: What is AI music for retail stores?
faq.a: AI music for retail stores is original audio generated by machine-learning models trained on music data, configured for the parameters that affect retail customer behavior — tempo, key, instrumentation, lyrical density, energy arc, and cultural reference set. Unlike licensed catalog music, the tracks are produced for the specific store's customer profile and outcome, not picked from a fixed library.

faq.q: How is AI music different from a Spotify playlist or a commercial music service?
faq.a: Three differences. First, the music is original — produced for the store rather than licensed from a fixed catalog, which means no PRO royalties (ASCAP, BMI, SESAC) and no catalog fatigue. Second, the parameters are tunable to the customer, not the genre. Third, the system can ingest sales and traffic data and refine the audio against the store's outcomes. Spotify and commercial catalog services do none of these.

faq.q: Is AI music legally safe to use in a retail store?
faq.a: Yes, when the vendor structures the rights properly. Entuned's tracks are original, commercial-use cleared, and PRO-indemnified the moment they play — every subscription includes a written indemnification certificate. By contrast, using a personal Spotify or Apple Music subscription in a commercial space violates copyright law and the consumer terms of service, regardless of whether the music was AI-generated.

faq.q: Does AI music actually sound good?
faq.a: The technology crossed the commercial quality threshold in late 2025. Top-tier generative music systems now produce audio that the median customer cannot distinguish from human-composed background music in a retail context. The relevant test is not whether a trained musician can tell the difference in a studio. It is whether the audio holds the customer in the consideration moment in your store. The 2026 generation does, in most categories.

faq.q: What does AI music for retail cost?
faq.a: AI retail music is priced per location per month, like commercial catalog music. Entuned Free — indefinite, no card required. Core is $99 per location per month. Professional is $399 per location per month. Enterprise is negotiated for multi-fleet rollouts. The pricing is publicly listed, unlike legacy commercial music vendors that quote per-deal.
